mapping.criteria: L1 and L2 independently agree on a unique strongest column; at least 90% of eligible contacts support it; at least 10 contacts.
mapping.projection: x=sqrt(3)/2*(hex1-hex2), y=-(hex1+hex2)/2; full L1/L2 column extent centered in a unit square
mapping.limitations: Inferred column identity and uncalibrated video projection; not a registered camera retina, measured receptive field, or motion detector.
